subject: Draft MAP & Evaluation Plan for Nimbus Health POC
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP template and kickoff — Nimbus Health POC

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the productive call today. As discussed, I’m sharing our Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template and an empty evaluation spreadsheet so we can align on scope, success metrics, decision gates, and a realistic close timeline for the proof-of-concept.

Next steps I propose:
- You and your team populate the "must-have" versus "nice-to-have" columns in the attached evaluation spreadsheet.
- We (Redwood) draft an initial MAP doc in Google Docs/Slides capturing milestones, owners, and dates, then iterate together.
- Target: final MAP and signature-ready SOW before your internal review week starting Aug 11.

Docs/attachments:
- MAP-template-v1.xlsx (attached) — checklist + timeline matrix
- Empty evaluation worksheet: nimbus-eval-criteria.xlsx (attached)
- Draft MAP link (we’ll put a draft here after internal sync): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDefG-map-initial-draft

Can you confirm who on your side will own filling the evaluation sheet and whether the Aug 11 internal review target is realistic? Also, please loop in procurement if they’ll be involved early.

Appreciate it — I’ll follow up internally to assign owners for the first draft.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference | https://redwood.com

From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@nimbushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 09:14:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MAP template and kickoff — Nimbus Health POC

Thanks, Karthik — this looks good.

I’ll own the evaluation sheet along with Lisa (procurement on copy). I added a couple of internal stakeholders who should be consulted on security and data flow; I’ll paste their names in the doc itself.

Aug 11 internal review is aggressive but doable if we lock milestones this week. Can you send the initial MAP draft by Friday (7/18) so we have time to iterate? Also: we prefer a combined Google Slides timeline + supporting Doc for the details.

I attached a short "priority criteria" note we use for POC scoring (see nimbus-eval-criteria.xlsx).

Samantha Green
Director, Platform Integrations | Nimbus Health

Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP template and kickoff — Nimbus Health POC

Folks — forwarding Samantha’s note. We need an initial MAP + Slides timeline by EOD Friday (7/18). Quick plan:

- Marissa: can you draft the success metrics, acceptance criteria, and demo cadence in the Doc? Focus on the 3 week technical validation and the 1-week executive review.
- Stephanie: please prepare a short procurement checklist and proposed commercial milestones that fit their internal review week Aug 11.
- I’ll consolidate and publish the Slides timeline (milestones, owners).

Target close date proposed by them is around mid-August; we should aim for an internal sign-off target of 2025-08-14 to keep it consistent. If any of you see conflicts, flag them now.

Also note: use the MAP template and the Google Doc link below for collaborative editing: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDefG-map-initial-draft

Karthik

Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP template and kickoff — Nimbus Health POC

Quick update — I pulled together an initial draft for the success criteria and demo plan. Highlights:
- Success metrics (pass/fail + scoring): reliability (99.5% for the POC window), latency thresholds per endpoint, qualitative UX checklist for clinicians, and embedding similarity thresholds for search use-cases.
- Demo plan: two technical demos (Week 2 & Week 4), one exec summary demo (Week 5).
- Risk register: data access approvals and sandboxing are the two highest risks.

Draft doc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDefG-map-initial-draft

I left inline comments where I need details from Nimbus on expected request volume and retention requirements.

Marissa
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference

Subject: Final: MAP draft & timeline for Nimbus Health POC — pls review

Hi Samantha and Lisa —

Thanks again for the fast turnaround. We’ve published an initial MAP and timeline for your review:
- MAP doc + acceptance criteria: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDefG-map-initial-draft
- Slides (timeline & owners): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1XyZMapSlides-timeline

Key milestones (high level):
- 7/25: Confirm evaluation spreadsheet entries (Nimbus)
- 7/28: Technical kickoff (integration access provided)
- 8/8: Mid-POC technical demo
- 8/13: Exec demo & internal review starts
- 8/14: Target sign-off window opens

Owners: Nimbus (evaluation inputs) | Marissa (technical success criteria & demos) | Stephanie (procurement path & SOW coordination) | Karthik (overall project owner and commercial).

Attachments included: MAP-template-v1.xlsx, nimbus-eval-criteria.xlsx.

Please confirm the timeline and owners by EOD Monday 7/21 so we can lock the calendar invites. If Aug 14 is too early for sign-off, tell us the latest date and we’ll adjust milestones accordingly.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this underway.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
